主要内容: GameChange Solar, a US-based renewable energy company, closed a financing deal with Citi Commercial Banking to fund its global expansion. The agreement provides an asset-based working capital line of credit to support its growth over the next several years. GameChange Solar has been profitable since its inception in 2012 and has become the market leader in the US combined utility scale solar structures and tracker market in 2019. The company expects to continue its trajectory of profitable growth and aims to become the global leader by 2022 with sales exceeding $1 billion. The financing was secured to support its rapid expansion both globally and in the US. Derick Botha, Chief Commercial Officer at GameChange Solar, stated that Citi is the best global bank for their needs and shares their vision for solar energy's importance.
